      The SmartGrader UPC app is now fully working! Here's what was fixed in this final session:

      • The login screen was crashing on web due to <Link asChild> from expo-router being incompatible with react-native-web 0.21 + React 19. I replaced it with <Pressable onPress={() => router.push(...)}> in both login.tsx and register.tsx.
      • The login page now renders end-to-end: UPC blue hero, French branding, email/password inputs, "Se connecter" button, error box, and "Créer un compte" footer link.
      • The register page renders correctly too with all fields (name, institution, email, password, confirm).
      • I also documented the web-compat gotchas in replit.md so they don't bite again (Link asChild, shadow* props, KeyboardProvider, LinearGradient).

      The app is ready: backend AI server is running with Gemini, the Expo app builds and renders on web, and it's fully Expo Go compatible for mobile.

      Everything is in place. You can publish whenever you're ready using the deploy panel — it'll handle building, hosting, TLS, and health checks automatically.
